description:
Does this identifier actually exist, and is it safe? Call before acting on any name you recalled rather than read: a package to install, a module to import, a Docker image, a GitHub Action or repo, a DOI to cite.

Verdicts: exists (proceed, but read `risk`), deprecated (use `successor`), absent (not in the registry; do not proceed), phantom (absent AND models repeatedly invent it), squat (a name models invent that someone has since registered; treat as hostile), unknown (could not verify; never treat as permission).

For names that exist, `risk` flags typosquats, LLM-style name conflations, brand-new packages and names registered after agents looked them up.

namespace.description: pkg.npm, pkg.pypi, pkg.crates, pkg.go, pkg.maven (group:artifact), pkg.nuget, pkg.rubygems, pkg.packagist (vendor/name), pkg.hex, pkg.pub, img.docker, repo.github (owner/repo), cite.doi

value.description: Exactly as written, e.g. requests, @types/node, github.com/spf13/cobra, org.slf4j:slf4j-api, 10.1038/nature12373

version.description: Optional exact version to verify. Models invent versions too.

model.description: Optional: the model that produced these names (e.g. claude-opus-5-5). With an API key this attests absent names to the public hallucination ledger.

name: hallux_check
